diff:
--- a/tests/test_rename_user.py
+++ b/tests/test_rename_user.py
@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+import pytest
+
+from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user, handle_rename_user
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def restore_user_one():
+    """Yield the current user 1 and restore its original name afterwards."""
+    original = handle_get_user({"id": "1"})[1]
+    yield original
+    handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": original["name"]})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_ok(restore_user_one):
+    status, user = handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": "Ada Byron"})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert user == {"id": 1, "name": "Ada Byron", "email": "ada@example.com"}
+
+
+def test_rename_user_visible_through_get_user(restore_user_one):
+    handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": "Ada Byron"})
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"id": 1, "name": "Ada Byron", "email": "ada@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_trims_whitespace(restore_user_one):
+    status, user = handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": "  Ada Byron  "})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert user["name"] == "Ada Byron"
+
+
+def test_rename_user_accepts_max_length_name(restore_user_one):
+    name = "a" * 50
+    status, user = handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": name})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert user["name"] == name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("params", [
+    {},
+    {"name": "Ada"},
+    {"id": "abc", "name": "Ada"},
+    {"id": 1, "name": "Ada"},
+    {"id": None, "name": "Ada"},
+])
+def test_rename_user_invalid_id(params):
+    assert handle_rename_user(params) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", [
+    "",
+    "   ",
+    "a" * 51,
+    123,
+    None,
+])
+def test_rename_user_invalid_name(name):
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": name}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_missing_name():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_not_found():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": "Ada"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_id_checked_before_name():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "abc", "name": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_name_checked_before_existence():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
